I turned my Grok Bot that generates art assets into a template that you can use.

- It will generate 2D art assets in the style that you specify
- It can also generate multiple mockups of your game idea in multiple styles
- It can crop your art assets into separate PNG assets for… https://t.co/7neF0HhOIu pic.twitter.com/BmyiD72MTE
